title: AGQO fresh-inference tail probe

test_design.classification: new-tail diagnostic; data window previously visible in project analyses; not a blind holdout

data.return_price_basis: VCI OHLC điều chỉnh theo sự kiện quyền; dùng close_adjusted cho lợi suất.
data.execution_price_basis: DNSE OHLC thô; dùng open/close cho giá khớp giả định và close×volume làm đại diện thanh khoản.
data.portfolio_marking_basis: Dùng tỷ lệ open_adjusted giữa ngày vào và ngày ra; lợi suất tổng hợp, không phải sổ kế toán tiền mặt/cổ phiếu theo từng sự kiện doanh nghiệp.
data.membership: Dùng lịch VN30 theo ngày hiệu lực; mỗi tín hiệu chỉ xét thành viên có hiệu lực ở ngày tín hiệu.
data.corporate_action_completeness: Nguồn VCI xác nhận giá đã điều chỉnh theo sự kiện quyền; chưa đối chiếu độc lập từng cổ tức, chia tách, cổ phiếu thưởng và quyền mua.
data.liquidity_measure: close thô nhân volume là đại diện thanh khoản, không phải giá trị khớp lệnh đã xác nhận.
data.news_usage: No external news records supplied; news is not used in guidance or result explanation.
data.opening_price_assumption: Mô phỏng khớp tại giá mở cửa phiên kế tiếp; giá thô, chưa tính trượt giá/thuế/lô giao dịch.

prompt_payload.information_cutoff: Use features available on the signal date and completed portfolio periods with exit dates no later than the signal date.

dataset_profile.market: Vietnam equities; daily point-in-time VN30 constituent intervals; DNSE raw execution prices and VCI rights-adjusted price series.
known_limitations: Historical membership intervals are curated from exchange review records and should be audited against each source link.
VCI states prices are adjusted for entitlement events; each cash dividend, split, bonus issue and rights event has not been independently reconciled.
Portfolio wealth is marked through adjusted-open return ratios; this is a synthetic total-return approximation, not an event-level cash-and-share ledger.
Close multiplied by volume is a traded-value proxy, not verified exchange turnover.
Historical simulation with modeled fees and capacity is not proof of executable profit.
If news_context is supplied, counts reflect source first-seen timestamps and issuer-name queries; they are not verified publication times, sentiment, or causal attribution.

regime_classifier.target: Whether forward 21-session realized volatility exceeds a training-only 70th-percentile threshold.
regime_classifier.output: Probability of a high-volatility regime; this is not a return forecast or a trading signal.

reliability_to_date.interpretation: Negative skill means this classifier has been less accurate than its training-prevalence baseline on matured prior signals.

news_context.reason: No local, point-in-time news metadata was supplied.

high_volatility.condition: AI high-volatility probability >= threshold, at least minimum_matured_signals exist, and Brier skill is positive.

high_dispersion.condition: Cross-sectional standard deviation of compounded 20-session stock returns >= threshold.

bank_concentration.condition: Bank share of eligible stocks >= threshold.

low_liquidity.condition: Median candidate close-times-volume proxy over the prior 20 sessions < minimum daily value needed to fill one equal-weight position at the configured participation limit.

mixed_signals.condition: Use only when none of the other insight conditions are supported.

qaoa_objective_specification.formula: minimize lambda * (x^T Sigma_alpha x) / K^2 - (mu^T x) / K + annualized modeled transaction cost
qaoa_objective_specification.interpretation: Select exactly K assets; trade off estimated covariance risk, historical expected return and estimated rebalance cost.
qaoa_objective_specification.lambda_meaning: Risk penalty relative to the expected-return term; not a probability.
qaoa_objective_specification.alpha_meaning: Diagonal covariance shrinkage strength; not a return forecast.
qaoa_objective_specification.previous_weight_source: Prior AGQO portfolio; initial portfolio is cash.

evaluation_metric_definitions.net_monthly_return: Portfolio monthly return after modeled buy and sell fees.
evaluation_metric_definitions.sharpe: sqrt(12) * mean(monthly excess return) / sample standard deviation(monthly excess return); monthly risk-free rate is assumed to be zero.
evaluation_metric_definitions.sortino: sqrt(12) * mean(monthly excess return) / sqrt(mean(min(monthly excess return, 0)^2)).
evaluation_metric_definitions.max_drawdown: Minimum compounded-wealth-to-prior-running-peak ratio minus 1; more negative is worse.
evaluation_metric_definitions.monthly_cvar_95: Mean monthly return among observations at or below the empirical 5th percentile; more negative is worse.
evaluation_metric_definitions.mean_two_way_turnover: Average sum of absolute portfolio weight changes per rebalance; includes liquidation outside the candidate universe.
evaluation_metric_definitions.normalized_objective_regret: (best feasible QAOA objective - exact minimum) / objective range across feasible portfolios; lower is better and zero matches the exact optimum.
evaluation_metric_definitions.feasible_sample_probability: Fraction of measured QAOA shots selecting exactly K assets; it is not a probability of profit.
evaluation_metric_definitions.logical_gate_count: Simulator-level logical gate proxy, not a hardware-native gate count or runtime advantage claim.

prompt_payload.decision_rule: Select one existing policy id. Prefer completed, fee-adjusted evidence; consider risk, objective regret, feasible-sample rate and logical circuit cost together. Fewer than 6 completed periods is weak evidence. Do not infer future returns or add unsupported facts.

method_notes.title: How to interpret QAOA solution quality
method_notes.text: For each small portfolio instance, exact enumeration is the classical optimum reference. The reported normalized objective regret is (best feasible sampled QAOA objective - exact minimum) divided by the objective range over feasible portfolios; lower is better and 0 means the sampled solution matched the exact optimum. Feasible-sample probability is the fraction of measured shots with exactly K selections, not the probability of financial profit. Report the distribution across seeds and dates, plus logical gate counts and wall time. Compare with exact, greedy and simulated annealing on the same objective; exact being faster at these N is a valid result, not a failure to report.

method_notes.title: Vietnam equity dataset limitations
method_notes.text: The walk-forward uses a curated VN30 membership interval file and selects constituents effective on each signal date; review source links must still be audited. Returns use VCI OHLC prices documented as adjusted for entitlement events, and portfolio wealth is marked through adjusted-open return ratios as a synthetic total-return approximation, not an event-level cash-and-share ledger. Raw DNSE prices are used for assumed execution and close*volume. Completeness of each dividend, split, bonus issue and rights event has not been independently reconciled. close*volume remains only a liquidity proxy. The backtest uses modeled fees and capacity, not confirmed executable fills. Treat results as research evidence, not deployable profit.
method_notes.source: Project data manifest and experiment configuration

method_notes.title: Meaning and units of the VN30 and cross-sectional fields
method_notes.text: Interpret market fields as follows. VN30 annualized volatility over 20/60/120 sessions is the sample standard deviation of daily VN30 returns multiplied by sqrt(252). VN30 return_20d and return_60d are cumulative compounded returns. volatility_ratio_20d_to_120d above 1 means recent 20-session volatility exceeds its 120-session level; it describes change, not direction of prices. mean_pairwise_correlation_252d and its 90th percentile summarize correlations among eligible-stock returns in the trailing 252-session estimation window; higher correlation can reduce diversification but does not prove causation. cross_sectional_20d_return_dispersion is the sample standard deviation across stocks of their cumulative 20-session returns; fraction_stocks_positive_20d is the share with a positive cumulative return. bank_fraction_of_eligible_stocks and candidate_group_fraction describe the current data snapshot's group mix. candidate_*_daily_traded_value_proxy_vnd is close multiplied by volume, averaged over the prior 20 sessions; it is denominated in VND and is only a liquidity proxy, not verified executable capacity.

method_notes.title: Definitions of the financial evaluation metrics
method_notes.text: Use these project definitions. Net monthly return includes the modeled buy and sell fees. CAGR=(product(1+r_month))^(12/month_count)-1. Annualized Sharpe=sqrt(12)*mean(monthly excess return)/sample standard deviation(monthly excess return); monthly risk-free rate is assumed to be 0. Sortino uses sqrt(mean(min(excess_return,0)^2)) as monthly downside deviation and the same sqrt(12) annualization. Maximum drawdown is the minimum of compounded wealth divided by its prior running peak, minus 1. Monthly CVaR95 is the mean return among observations at or below the empirical 5th percentile; more negative is worse. Mean two-way turnover is the average total absolute portfolio weight traded per rebalance, including liquidation of holdings outside the candidate universe. Higher Sharpe/CAGR and lower drawdown/CVaR/turnover are not interchangeable objectives; read them together.

method_notes.title: Limits and reliability of the volatility-regime submodel
method_notes.text: The logistic submodel estimates the probability that forward 21-session realized VN30 volatility exceeds the 70th percentile of the initial training-period volatility distribution. It does not predict return sign, stock returns, or profitability. The reported Brier score evaluates prior monthly probabilities against matured outcomes; lower is better. Brier skill is 1 - model Brier / expanding training-prevalence Brier; negative skill means the model lost to that baseline. Monthly forecasts overlap in their 21-session labels, so they are not independent observations. If fewer than six monthly forecasts have matured or skill is negative, regard the latest probability as weak, do not increase risk or QAOA depth because of it, and rely on measured policy outcomes and the deterministic supervisor.

method_notes.title: QAOA depth, mixers and feasibility
method_notes.text: N candidate assets map to N logical qubits and the portfolio constraint is exactly K selected assets. The X mixer can leave the feasible-cardinality subspace, so this implementation adds a penalty and records the measured feasible-sample rate. The XY mixer preserves Hamming weight and can remain in the K-feasible subspace when initialized there. p is the number of alternating cost/mixer layers; greater p and denser mixer layouts increase logical circuit work and do not by themselves prove better solutions or hardware advantage. The reported logical two-qubit gate proxy counts nonzero cost couplings per layer; an XY mixer adds two logical gates (RXX and RYY) per mixer edge and layer. It excludes hardware transpilation, routing and error correction. Ring, linear, complete and correlation layouts are empirical alternatives to compare under the same instances, shots, seeds and objective.
method_notes.source: Farhi, Goldstone & Gutmann (2014), https://arxiv.org/abs/1411.4028; Hadfield et al. (2019), https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.03489

method_notes.title: Portfolio objective and parameter meaning
method_notes.text: The solver minimizes lambda*(x^T Sigma_alpha x)/K^2 - (mu^T x)/K + annualized modeled transaction cost, subject to exactly K selected assets. x is a binary selection vector. Sigma_alpha=(1-alpha)*sample_covariance + alpha*diagonal(sample_covariance); alpha is diagonal shrinkage, not a return forecast. Lambda controls the risk penalty relative to the expected-return term; it is not a probability. Costs use the previous portfolio, per-asset fee rates, and 12 rebalances per year in this experiment. These estimates use historical data and do not guarantee future returns.

controller_contract.task: Select one eligible QAOA policy and identify supported market insight codes.
selection_order: Only compare matured, completed policy outcomes available by as_of_date.
Compare net return with Sharpe, drawdown, CVaR, turnover, fees, exact-solver regret, and feasible-shot rate.
If evidence is comparable, prefer fewer logical two-qubit gates.
controller_contract.output: JSON only; no rationale or risk flags. Local deterministic code creates Vietnamese explanations.

llm.quantization: FP8 (official Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint); FP8 KV cache

raw_envelope.quantization: FP8 (official Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint); FP8 KV cache

llm.grounded_narrative: Đề xuất 12 qubit, bộ trộn XY/ring, p=1, khoảng 90 cổng hai qubit logic mỗi mạch; độ phân tán lợi suất 20 phiên là 6.2%; ngân hàng chiếm 43.3% rổ đủ điều kiện.
llm.risk_note: Brier skill của bộ dự báo không dương hoặc chưa đủ sáu tín hiệu tháng đã trưởng thành. Sai lệch mục tiêu QAOA bình quân từ 10%. Bộ giám sát chuyển sang đối chứng vì regret cao. Cấu hình thực thi: n12_balanced_x_p2.

decision.guardrail_reason: The proposal's mean normalized objective regret exceeds 10% and trails the rule comparator by over 5 percentage points.

financial_test.interpretation: 12-session one-step test; net portfolio uses simulated partial fills, modeled fees and capacity-limited terminal sales; index price benchmarks exclude investability costs.

limitations: Only one LLM decision and 12 market sessions; annualized Sharpe is descriptive and unstable.
This data tail was not scored in the old portfolio table but the market dates were already present in project artifacts; it is not a blind holdout.
Point-in-time membership is used from the documented VN30 review timeline; reviewed intervals should still be audited against HOSE source records.

VCI price adjustment is used for returns, but each cash dividend, split, bonus issue and rights event has not been independently reconciled; tax, lot size, impact and halted-stock execution are not modeled.
Raw close×volume remains a liquidity proxy and does not replace confirmed traded value or order-book capacity.
QAOA runs on a classical simulator; gate counts are logical circuit proxies and cannot establish quantum advantage.
No external news feed was used in this probe; price moves are not attributed to specific events.
The monthly historical portfolio entries/exits in source results remain based on the existing backtest assumptions.
